_comment: Domains and data elements of the operations framework. The area of a run, finding, alert rule, lock and purge target is ZCA_PARAM_AREA_ID of the parameter framework (one area register); the other fields use built-in types and SAP data elements, except the status of a control (2026-11-10: fixed values with translatable texts, shown by the review app and the consumers' cards). tools/abapgit_serialize.py writes src/<name>.doma.xml / .dtel.xml for every entry added here. Labels: short <= 10, medium <= 20, long <= 40, heading <= 55, text <= 60 characters.
